newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt police kill three militants in south.
newsitem.headline: Egypt police kill three militants in south.

text.p: Egyptian police shot dead three suspected Moslem militants and wounded another in a shootout in a village in southern Egypt on Friday, security sources said.
They said the incident took place in a village near the town of Somosta in Beni Seuif province, south of Cairo, when police were tipped off that the militants were hiding there.
The sources said the militants were wanted for staging attacks in southern Egypt.
There were no police casualties, they added.

Police in Beni Seuif believe the men were members of the violent militant al-Gama'a al-Islamiya (Islamic Group), which has been fighting to overthrow the Egyptian government and set up a strict Islamic state.
More than 1,000 people, mostly militants and police, have been killed in political violence in Egypt since militants took up arms in 1992.
